ONTraC parameters

ontracParam.Rd

Parameters for GiottoClass::analyzeData() that run ONTraC (Wang et al. 2025), which builds niche trajectories with a graph neural network on cell-type composition of each cell's neighbourhood. ONTraC is a Python package; it is installed in a cached environment the first time it runs (through reticulate::py_require(), needs reticulate >= 1.41). If you use it, please cite the original paper (see References).

Usage

ontracParam(
  k = 6L,
  n_neighbors = 50L,
  n_local = 20L,
  epochs = 1000L,
  patience = 100L,
  min_epochs = 50L,
  lr = 0.03,
  hidden_feats = 4L,
  n_gcn_layers = 2L,
  modularity_loss_weight = 1,
  purity_loss_weight = 30,
  regularization_loss_weight = 0.1,
  beta = 0.3,
  seed = 42L,
  device = c("cpu", "cuda"),
  n_cpu = 4L,
  version = "2.1.2",
  out_dir = NULL,
  ...
)

# S4 method for class 'data.frame,ontracParam'
analyzeData(x, param, ...)

Arguments

k

integer, number of niche clusters (at most 8)

n_neighbors

integer, neighbours for the niche network

n_local

integer, index of the local neighbour used to normalize distances

epochs, patience, min_epochs

integer, training length

lr

numeric, learning rate

hidden_feats, n_gcn_layers

integer, model size

modularity_loss_weight, purity_loss_weight, regularization_loss_weight, beta

numeric, loss weights (ONTraC's defaults)

seed

integer, seed

device

"cpu" or "cuda"

n_cpu

integer, CPUs for building the niche network

version

ONTraC version installed on first use

out_dir

directory for ONTraC's files; NULL uses a temporary one

...

further ONTraC command line options as name = value, e.g. "trajectory-construct" = "BF"

x

data.frame with columns cell_ID, sdimx, sdimy, cell_type and optionally sample

param

an ontracParam

Value

An ontracParam object.

Details

analyzeData(x, param) returns a data.table with cell_ID, NTScore, niche_cluster (the most likely cluster) and one probability column per niche cluster (NicheCluster_0, ...). Its attributes niche_clusters (each cluster's NT score), connectivity (cluster x cluster) and out_dir hold the niche-level results.

References

Wang W, Zheng S, Shin SC, Chávez-Fuentes JC, Yuan GC. ONTraC characterizes spatially continuous variations of tissue microenvironment through niche trajectory analysis. Genome Biology 26, 117 (2025). doi:10.1186/s13059-025-03588-5

See also

runONTraC()

Examples

p <- ontracParam(k = 6, epochs = 200)
p$k
